about: Solomon asks the angel when the saviour will come and is told: in forty-three generations, from his own seed, after Israel has crucified him. Grieved for his people, he laments in words close to the Wisdom of Solomon: the king and the poor share one grave, breath is smoke, and the name is forgotten in three generations. He then charges his son Jeroboam to do good and shun other gods, orders the words written down, and has Zadok anoint Jeroboam king while he lives.

sentences.i: He turned, looked up toward the angel, spread out both his hands, and said, “O Lord, is the coming of the saviour you spoke of near, or is it far?” The angel answered him and said, “In forty-three generations he will come from your kin and from your seed, and will save you;
sentences.n: Solomon speaks to the angel who has spoken since ch. 67 and addresses him as እግዚኦ, the vocative of እግዚእ. Verbs in ወ- + 3ms perfect: ወተመይጠ (tä-stem ‘turn’), ወአንቃዕደወ (‘lift the eyes, look up’; the stem and root I cannot analyse with certainty (?)), ወሰፍሐ ‘spread out’; ክልኤሆን is ‘both’ with the feminine suffix because እደው ‘hands’ is taken as feminine. ቀርበኑ and ርሑቅኑ are perfect and adjective with the question-enclitic -ኑ (‘is it near? is it far?’), ወሚመ ‘or’; ዘትቤ is ዘ- ‘which’ + 2ms ትቤ, the prefix form of the defective ይቤ used as a perfect. ምጽአቱ ‘his coming’ (ምጽአት + -ሁ). The number ፵ወ፫ with በ- reads ‘in forty-three’ (spoken አርብዓ ወሠለስቱ, arbəʿa wä-śälästu), followed by the singular ትውልድ ‘generation’, as is normal after a numeral; ‘forty-three’ is the text’s count (Matthew 1:17 counts three groups of fourteen). እምዘመድከ = እም- ‘from’ + ዘመድ ‘kin’ + -ከ; ወያድኅነክሙ is the 3ms of the causative አድኅነ ‘save’ + -ክሙ ‘you (pl.)’, the plural here because the line of Solomon is meant. The reply is cut at ፤ because it continues. The saviour’s coming and the crucifixion are prophesied here in plain terms.

sentences.i: but Israel will hate their saviour and will be jealous against him because of the wonders and marvels he did before them; they will crucify him and kill him, and he will rise and save you;
sentences.n: ወእስራኤልሰ = ወ- + እስራኤል + the contrastive -ሰ ‘as for Israel’. ይጸልኡ ‘they hate’ (ጸለአ) and ይቀንኡ ‘they are zealous, jealous’ (ቀንአ) are 3mp imperfects; ላዕሌሁ ‘against him’ (ላዕለ + -ሁ). በዘገብረ = በ- ‘because of’ + ዘ- + ገብረ ‘(that) which he did’, with ተኣምረ ወመንክረ ‘wonder and marvel’ as accusative objects in apposition. The three verbs ይሰቅልዎ ‘they will crucify him’, ይቀትልዎ ‘they will kill him’, ይትነሣእ ‘he will rise’ (tä-stem of ንሥአ), with -ዎ ‘him’ added to the first two; the resurrection has no object because it is intransitive. The unit ends on the same promise of salvation, ‘and he will save you’, as the angel’s first clause.

sentences.i: And now I have told you for certain that he will not leave you in Sheol, you the kin (?) of Israel, among whom the pearl was carried.” And having said this, the angel of God said to him, “Peace to you.”
sentences.n: ወናሁ ‘and behold’; ነገርኩክሙ ‘I told you (pl.)’ (1cs perfect + -ክሙ); ጥዩቀ ‘certainly’ (accusative of ጥዩቅ used as an adverb). ከመ ኢየኀድገክሙ ‘that he will not leave you’: negative ኢ- + 3ms subjunctive ይኀድግ of ኀደገ (the ይ- becomes የ- after ኢ-; a 1cs form would begin with አ-) + -ክሙ; the subject is the saviour of the preceding speech (?); ሲኦል ‘Sheol’, the place of the dead the saviour will empty. ለዘመዲ እስራኤል is doubtful (?): ለ- + ዘመድ ‘kin’ with a final -ዲ I cannot identify (an enclitic like -ሂ ‘also’, or a corrupt spelling), and the ለ- may mark the object or the persons addressed; I read it as an address, ‘you, kin of Israel’ (?). እለ ተጸውረት ባሕርይ ኀቤክሙ is a plural relative with a 3fs verb (‘who’ governing ‘the pearl was carried’); ተጸውረት is the passive of ጾረ ‘carry’, ባሕርይ ‘the pearl’ is the image of the saviour’s line (ch. 68), and ኀቤክሙ ‘with/among you (pl.)’. ብሂሎ is the gerund of the defective verb ‘say’ (‘having said’), ወዘንተ ‘and this’ (accusative); መልአከ is the construct of መልአክ before እግዚኣብሔር. The angel’s closing ሰላም ለከ is a greeting at leave-taking.

sentences.n: ወካዕበ ‘and again’; አውሥኦ = አውሥአ ‘answered’ + -ኦ ‘him’ (the person answered is the object); መልአከ is the construct before እግዚኣብሔር. እወ ‘yes’; ነገርኩከ ‘I told you’. ለመድኅን is the object marked by ለ-, doubling the -ዎ ‘him’ on ይሰቅልዎ. ወሶበ ከዐዉ: ሶበ ‘when’ + 3mp perfect of ከዐወ ‘pour out’ (the dispersion follows the shedding of blood); ደሞ is ደም ‘blood’ + the 3ms suffix -ኦ ‘his’, as in ገጾ ‘his face’. ዕፀ መስቀል is ‘tree-of cross’, a construct chain, ‘the wood of the cross’. ይከውኑ ዝርዋነ is ‘they will be scattered ones’, with ዝርዋነ (accusative of ዝርው ‘scattered’) as the predicate; the dispersion of Israel is the answer to Solomon’s grief.

sentences.i: woe to them, my people, who have always provoked their Creator to anger, from the first to the last, I and those before me; and it is not right that mercy be shown us (?) because of the evil of our deeds, for we are a generation that has no faith;
sentences.n: አሌሎሙ is አሌ ‘woe’ + ለ- + -ሙ ‘to them’ (a cry of lament, like Latin vae). ያምዕዑ is 3mp imperfect of the causative አምዐ ‘provoke to wrath’ (root m-ʿ-ʿ, of ምዕዐ ‘be angry’) with ፈጣሪሆሙ ‘their creator’ as object (+ -ሆሙ). እምቀዳሚ ወእስከ ደኃሪ ‘from first to last’. ወእለ እምቅድሜየ = ‘and those who (were) before me’ (እም- + ቅድሜ- + -የ). ወኢይደሉ is ኢ- + 3ms of ደለወ ‘be fitting’; ይምሐሩነ ‘they (should) have mercy on us’ is a 3mp subjunctive of ምሕረ (with ሐ, ‘be merciful’, not ምሀረ ‘teach’), whose subject is unexpressed (God, in honorific plural, or ‘those who judge’) (?). በእንተ እከየ ምግባሪነ = ‘because of the evil-of our deeds’ (a construct, with the suffix -ነ on the last noun). ዘአልብነ አሚነ = ዘ- ‘which’ + አልብነ ‘we have not’ (አልቦ + 1cp) + አሚነ ‘faith’ (accusative).

sentences.n: ይክዕዉ ‘they pour out’ (3mp imperfect of ከዐወ, as in the previous unit) with ደመ ንጹሐ ‘innocent blood’ (ንጹሐ accusative of ንጹሕ). ይጠቅሉ is unclear (?): I take it as a verb of seizing or binding with ጻድቀ ‘the righteous one’ as object (the saviour, though the plural may be general); the verb is not known to me (ጠቀለ ‘wrap, bind’ may be meant (?)). ይትካፈሉ በርበራቲሁ ‘they share out his spoils’ (tä-stem of ከፈለ ‘divide’; በርበራት ‘plunder’ + -ሁ ‘his’), recalling the soldiers dividing the garments, Matthew 27:35. ወኢየአምኑ ‘and they do not believe’ (አምነ) and ወኢየሐውሩ ‘they do not walk’ (ሖረ), with በቃሉ ‘by/in his word’ and በትእዛዙ ‘in his commandment’ (the -ሁ ‘his’ of the suffixed noun contracts to -ሉ, -ዙ).

sentences.i: their judgment is firm and their guilt abiding, their punishment is great and their sin heavy, and it is not forgiven them; they call to mind the sin of their fathers, for their deeds are sin, and they perish by what they themselves plotted;
sentences.n: The clauses are verbless adjective + noun-with-suffix (‘firm their-judgment’), each ‘X is Y’: ጽኑሕ ‘firm’, ንቡር ‘abiding, standing’, ዐቢይ ‘great’. The nouns are ደይን ‘judgment’, ጌጋይ ‘guilt, fault’, መቅሠፍት ‘scourge, punishment’ and ኀጢአት ‘sin’, each + -ሙ ‘their’. ኢይሰሪ is 3ms of ሰረየ ‘forgive’ (written with ሰ) with ኢ-, ሎሙ ‘to them’: ‘it is not forgiven them’ or ‘he does not forgive them’ (?). ያዜክሩ is the 3mp causative (አዘከረ) of ዘከረ ‘remember, mention’ (the verb of ይዜክር in the last unit of the lament; ዘከረ has ይዜክር as its usual imperfect), ‘they bring to mind’ (?); the subject is unclear, and the unit may mean ‘they recall [as a defence] their fathers’ sin’, or ‘[their sin] reminds [God of] their fathers’ sin’ (?). ኀጢአተ is the construct before አበዊሆሙ ‘their fathers’. ይትሀጐሉ ‘they perish’ (tä-stem of ሀጕለ); በዘመከሩ = በ- + ዘ- + መከረ ‘counsel, plan’ + ለሊሆሙ ‘they themselves’; the thought is that the wicked fall into their own pit (Psalm 7:15 is the idea).

sentences.n: ወባሕቱሰ ‘but indeed’ (ወ- + ባሕቱ + the contrastive -ሰ), then the turn from Israel to himself: አሌላ is አሌ + ለ- + -ኣ ‘her’, the feminine of አሌሎሙ above (ነፍስ ‘soul’ is feminine): ‘woe to her, to my soul’, the same doubling as አሌሎሙ ለሕዝብየ; ለነፍስየ ‘to my soul’ (ለ- + ነፍስ + -የ). ከበርኩ is 1cs perfect of ከብረ ‘be heavy, great, honoured’, and አኀስር 1cs imperfect of ኀሰረ ‘suffer loss’ (?), በሞትየ ‘through/by my death’: so the sense is probably ‘I have become great, yet I am the loser through dying’ (?). ተጠበብኩ is 1cs perfect of ተጠበበ ‘be wise, skilled’; ሐመደ ‘ashes, dust’ in the accusative, as predicate of ወእከውን ‘and I shall be’ (Genesis 3:19, Ecclesiastes 3:20).

sentences.l: What our-benefit for-man, for by-you (?) we-were-created and-after little we-shall-be like-one-who not-we-were-created;
sentences.i: What is our benefit, as men, since we were created by you (?), and after a little while we shall be as though we had never been created;
sentences.n: በቊዔትነ = በ- ‘in’ + ቊዔት ‘benefit’ + -ነ ‘our’; ለሰብእ ‘for man’. በከ ተፈጠርነ is uncertain (?): በ- + -ከ ‘by/in you’ would suddenly address God (or the angel) in the lament, which is abrupt but grammatical (‘we were created by you’); the word may instead be corrupt (?). I translate it as written and flag it. ተፈጠርነ is the 1cp passive perfect of ፈጠረ ‘create’. ወእምድኅረ ንስቲት ‘and after a little’ (ንስቲት ‘little’ as noun, fem.); ንከውን ‘we shall be’; ከመዘ = ከመ + ዘ- ‘like one who’, the two written together. The thought, and what follows it, comes from Wisdom of Solomon 2:2–5 (‘we were born by chance, and afterwards we shall be as though we had never been’), which the chapter is putting in Solomon’s mouth.

sentences.i: for our breath is smoke, and if it falls still for a little our soul passes away; and the word of [ቀለምጽጽልብነዘይትሐወስ, run together; unclear] in our mind. When it has passed we shall be dust, and our loved ones and our shame (?) will grieve us (?);
sentences.n: The source has a run-together string, ቀለምጽጽልብነዘይትሐወስ, which does not divide cleanly. Before it stands ወቃለ ‘and the word-of’ (ቃል in the construct), so the string would be the thing the word belongs to; I do not translate it (?); ልብነ ‘our heart’ and ዘይትሐወስ ‘which is stirred, moves’ (tä-stem of ሐወሰ) are present in it, and the whole may correspond to Wisdom 2:2, ‘speech is a spark struck from the beating of our heart’ (?), but I cannot make the reading certain. The rest: ጢስ ‘smoke’ (Wisdom 2:2: ‘the breath in our nostrils is smoke’), እስትንፋስነ ‘our breath’, ለእመ ‘if’, አርመመት ‘it falls silent’ (3fs perfect of አርመመ), ሕቀ ‘a little’, ተኀልፍ ‘it passes’ (3fs); the soul ነፍስነ is feminine. እምከመ ኀለፈት ‘after (when) it has passed’; ንከውን ሐመደ ‘we shall be dust’. ያስቆርሩነ is a 3mp causative with -ነ ‘us’, probably ‘they make us sorrowful, they grieve us’ (?), the verb not identified. ፍቁራኒነ is ‘our beloved ones’ (ፍቁራን + -ነ ‘our’, with the plural’s joining vowel, as in ኅሩያኒሁ above), and ማኅፈርነ ‘our shame’ or ‘our place of shame’ (?).

sentences.i: and the knowledge of our mind, which is above our head, when our soul has been poured out, we shall be ዕፄ ወጺአተ (unclear; see the note);
sentences.n: Crux (?): ዕፄ ወጺአተ, as in ch. 27 (there ዕፄ ወጺአት, left unread) and left as it stands. ዕፄ elsewhere is ‘emperor, king’, which does not fit here, and ወጺአተ may be ወ- + ጺአተ, perhaps for ጽአት ‘going out, departure’ (verbal noun of ወጽአ), which ch. 27 could not read (?); ‘we shall be [a] going-out’ is as far as I can go (?), and the whole may be an error for a clause meaning ‘we shall be as a passing breath’ (?). Apart from the crux: ወአእምሮ ‘and knowledge’ (verbal noun of አእመረ), ኅሊናነ ‘our mind’ (+ -ነ), ዘመልዕልተ ርእስነ ‘which (is) above our head’ (መልዕልተ ‘above’), ተክዕወት ‘was poured out’ (3fs passive of ከዐወ, as in the crucifixion speech above; the soul as a liquid, cf. Psalm 22:14).

sentences.i: and the warmth of our flesh, when it has passed, we shall be as nothing at all, and we pass away like the dispersal (?) of a cloud.
sentences.n: ወሙቀተ ሥጋነ ‘and the warmth-of our flesh’ (ሙቀት, a construct and accusative, + ሥጋ ‘flesh’ + -ነ ‘our’). The sentence is hanging, with ሙቀተ as an accusative of respect: ‘as for the warmth of our flesh’. ወኢምንትኒ ‘nothing at all’ (ወ- + ኢምንት ‘nothing’ + the enclitic -ኒ); ከመ ‘like’, the ወ- after it being redundant for the sense (‘like, and nothing at all’). ሳሕወ I cannot place (?): ‘dispersal, dissolving’ would fit the cloud (Wisdom 2:4, ‘our life will pass like the traces of a cloud and be scattered like a mist’), and ሳሕወ may be an accusative of ሳሐው, from a root ሰሐወ ‘dissolve, disperse’ (?). ነኀልፍ ‘we pass’ (1cp imperfect of ኀለፈ).

sentences.l: What-then? Having-multiplied speaking-even, not it-avails; and-the-beauty-of the-fair-one too it-perishes, and-the-might-of kings too it-vanishes, and-the-strength-of princes too it-perishes and-not it-is-found;
sentences.i: What then? Even speaking at length does not help; the beauty of the fair one perishes too, the might of kings vanishes too, and the strength of princes perishes too and is not found;
sentences.n: ምንተኬ ‘what then?’ (ምንት + -ኬ). አብዝኆ ነቢብኒ: the infinitive ነቢብ ‘speaking’ (+ -ኒ ‘even, too’) with the gerund አብዝኆ (of አብዝኀ ‘make many’: ‘having multiplied’); I take it as ‘even speaking much’. ኢይበቊዕ ‘it does not avail’. ወሥነ ላሕይኒ = ሥን ‘beauty’ (accusative/construct) + ላሕይ ‘fair, beautiful’ + -ኒ ‘too’; ወጽንዐ ነገሥትኒ ‘the might-of kings too’ (ጽንዕ, construct; ነገሥት plural of ንጉሥ); ወኀይለ መኳንንትኒ ‘the strength-of princes too’ (መኳንንት). The verbs are 3ms imperfects of ‘perish’ (ይጠፍእ, ይትሀጐል) and ‘be found’ (ይትረከብ, tä-stem of ረከበ). The refrain -ኒ ‘too’ ends each of the three subjects.

sentences.i: Then he turned his face toward Jeroboam his son and said to him, “My son, endure what is evil and do what is good, that you may live long on the earth;
sentences.n: ወሶቤሃ ‘and then’; አንጸረ ገጾ ‘he turned his face’ (አንጸረ ‘look toward’, as in earlier parts; with ገጽ ‘face’ it is ‘turn, direct the face’; ገጽ ‘face’ + -ኦ ‘his’ in the accusative). The name is spelled ዮርብዓም here but ኢዮርብዓም in the last unit and in earlier parts: the same man, Solomon’s son in this text (the biblical Jeroboam of 1 Kings 11–12 is not Solomon’s son; Bezold’s text gives the name where Rehoboam would be expected, as in ch. 68). ተዐገሳ is the imperative of ተዐገሠ ‘bear, be patient’ + -ኣ ‘it (f.)’; ለእኪት ‘the evil (thing)’ and ለሠናይት ‘the good (thing)’ are the objects, marked by ለ-, both fem. nouns. ግበራ = the imperative of ገብረ + -ኣ ‘do it’. ትርከብ ‘you find, obtain’ (2ms subjunctive of ረከበ), ብዙኀ መዋዕለ ‘many days’, a phrase from the Law (Deuteronomy 5:33, ‘that you may live long’).

sentences.i: do not bow down to other gods, nor worship them, but fear God and honour him, that you may overcome your enemy and your foes, and in the heavens too inherit your fathers’ dwelling, and inherit eternal life.”
sentences.n: ወኢትስግድ is the 2ms jussive of ሰገደ ‘bow down’ with ኢ-; ለአማልክት ባዕድ ‘to gods other’ (the plural አማልክት, with the singular adjective ባዕድ ‘strange’, the Geʿez idiom for ‘foreign gods’; Exodus 20:3, Deuteronomy 5:7). ወኢታምልኮሙ is 2ms jussive of አምለከ ‘treat as God, worship’ + -ሙ ‘them’. አላ ባሕቱ ‘but rather’; ፍራህ ‘fear!’ (imperative of ፈርሀ) and ወአክብሮ ‘and honour him!’ (imperative of አከበረ + -ኦ). ትማእ ‘you overcome’ is 2ms subjunctive of a verb I read as ‘conquer’, perhaps መውአ in a contracted spelling (?), ፀረከ ወጸላእተከ ‘your enemy and your foes’ (ጸላእተ the accusative plural of ጸላኢ, ፀር possibly collective; + -ከ). ወበሰማያትኒ ‘and in the heavens too’ (ሰማያት, plural, + -ኒ). ትረስ (twice) is the 2ms subjunctive of ወረሰ ‘inherit’ (which gives ይረስ; ረሰየ ‘make, set’ would give ትረሲ), ማኅደረ አበዊከ ‘the dwelling-of your fathers’ (the construct; the promise is of a place for the dead patriarchs), ሕይወተ ዘለዓለም ‘life of eternity’. The same verb governs both objects, as with ርስት ‘inheritance’ above.

sentences.i: as my father David, my lord, made me king while he lived, I too will make my son Jeroboam king; and may his seed be my salvation, mine and my fathers’, for ever, as the angel of God told me.”
sentences.n: በከመ ‘as’ + አንገሠኒ ‘he made me king’ (3ms perfect + -ኒ); the 1 Kings 1 account of David making Solomon king while he lived (1 Kings 1:32–48). እንዘ ሕያው ‘while living’ (እንዘ + the adjective). አነሂ ‘I too’ (+ -ሂ). ኣነግሦ is spelled with ኣ- (cf. ኣየድዐከ above): it is 1cs imperfect of አንገሠ + -ኦ ‘him’, ‘I shall make him king’. ኢዮርብዓም here, against ዮርብዓም in the charge above. እንዘ ሕያው አነሂ could instead be read ‘while I too am alive’, with ኣነግሦ (?); I take እንዘ ሕያው with David, as in 1 Kings 1. ወይኩን ዘርኡ መድኀኒትየ ‘and may his seed be my salvation’ (jussive of ኮነ; ዘርእ ‘seed’ + -ኡ ‘his’; መድኀኒት ‘salvation’ + -የ ‘my’); the saviour is to come from the line of Jeroboam, according to the pearl-doctrine of ch. 68, and Solomon is acting on that promise. ለአበውየ ‘for my forefathers’ (አበው, plural of አብ), እስከ ለዓለም ‘until for ever’. መልአከ is the construct before እግዚኣብሔር. The final run ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ marks the end of the chapter and has no ። before it; it stays with the last unit.

glossary.ቀለምጽጽልብነዘይትሐወስ: ቀለምጽጽልብነዘይትሐወስ — unintelligible run-together string, apparently several words fused; no lemma can be given (?)
glossary.ቀርበኑ: ቀርበ — is it near? (3ms perfect, G, q-r-b, 'be near, have come near'; + interrogative -ኑ)
glossary.በል: ብህለ — say! speak! (2ms imperative of the defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.በሞትየ: ሞት — by my death (በ- + noun + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.በርበራቲሁ: በርበራ — his spoils, plunder (noun, plural -ት + -ሁ '3ms his'; from በርበረ 'plunder') (?)
glossary.በቅድሜሆሙ: ቅድሜ — before them (በ- + noun ቅድሜ- + -ሆሙ '3mp them')
glossary.በቊዔትነ: ቊዔት — in our benefit (በ- + noun 'profit, benefit' + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.በትረ: በትር — rod, staff (construct 'rod of') · also accusative 'rod(s)' after a number (ሠለስተ በትረ 'three rods')
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በከ: በ — by you (በ- 'by, in' + -ከ '2ms you'); sense uncertain (?)
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በዘመከሩ: መከረ — by what they planned, plotted (በ- + ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, G, m-k-r)
glossary.በዘገብረ: ገብረ — by what he did, because of what he did (በ- + ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect)
glossary.በ፵ወ፫: ፵ወ፫ — in 43, spoken በአርብዓ ወሠለስቱ (bä-ʾärbəʿa wä-śälästu) 'in forty-three' (በ- + numeral; ሠለስቱ with the masculine ትውልድ, which follows in the singular) (?)
glossary.ባሕቱ: ባሕቱ — but, however, nevertheless (conjunction; አላ ባሕቱ 'but nevertheless')
glossary.ባዕድ: ባዕድ — another, a stranger (adjective/noun; ብእሲተ ባዕድ 'another man's wife') · 'strange, foreign' (አማልክተ ባዕድ 'strange gods')
glossary.ብሂሎ: ብህለ — having said (gerund, 3ms, of the defective verb b-h-l; 'and having said this')
glossary.ብቊዐኒ: በቊዐ — help me! (2ms imperative, G, b-q-ʿ + -ኒ '1cs me') (?)
glossary.ብዙኀ: ብዙኅ — many, much (adjective, masc. sg., accusative)
glossary.ተሰአለኒ: ተሰአለ — ask me! (2ms imperative, tä-stem, s-ʾ-l, + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ተኀልፍ: ኀለፈ — it passes away (3fs imperfect, G, ḫ-l-f)
glossary.ተክዕወት: ተከዕወ — it has been poured out (3fs perfect, passive tä-stem of ከዐወ; subject ነፍስ)
glossary.ተዐገሳ: ተዐገሠ — bear it! (2ms imperative, tä-stem, ʿ-g-ś + -ā '3fs it'; anticipates ለመዐት)
glossary.ተጸውረት: ተጸውረ — she was carried (3fs perfect, passive tä-stem of ጾረ 'carry'; subject ባሕርይ)
glossary.ተፈጠርነ: ተፈጥረ — we were created (1cp perfect, passive tä-stem of ፈጠረ 'create')
glossary.ትማእ: መውአ — you overcome, conquer (2ms subjunctive, G, m-w-ʾ; ትማእ a contracted spelling for ትመውእ) (?)
glossary.ትረስ: ወረሰ — you inherit (2ms subjunctive, G, w-r-s)
glossary.ትርከብ: ረከበ — you find, obtain (2ms subjunctive, G, r-k-b)
glossary.ትቤለኒ: ይቤ — you said to me (2ms ትቤ, the prefix form of defective ይቤ serving as its perfect, + -ለ- 'to' + -ኒ '1cs me'; verb b-h-l, as ዘትቤ)
glossary.ኀለፈት: ኀለፈ — it passed away (3fs perfect, ḫ-l-f)
glossary.ኀለፍነ: ኀለፈ — we have passed away (1cp perfect, G, ḫ-l-f)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ኀቤክሙ: ኀበ — to you (preposition, stem ኀቤ- + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ኀጢአተ: ኀጢአት — sin (noun, construct state 'sin-of') · accusative object, 'sin' (ያአትት ኀጢአተ 'he takes away sin')
glossary.ኀጢአት: ኀጢአት — sin (noun, fem.; here genitive after construct ርስሐተ 'defilement of sin') · after ዘእንበለ (ዘእንበለ ኀጢአት 'without sin') · predicate, 'are sin' (ምግባሮሙ ኀጢአት)
glossary.ኅይስናሁ: ኅይስና — his worth, excellence (noun + -ሁ '3ms his'; meaning and stem uncertain) (?)
glossary.ነቢብኒ: ነቢብ — speaking, speech (verbal noun of ነበበ 'speak') + enclitic -ኒ 'even, too'
glossary.ነኀልፍ: ኀለፈ — we pass away (1cp imperfect, G, ḫ-l-f)
glossary.ነገሥትኒ: ንጉሥ — kings too (plural ነገሥት + enclitic -ኒ 'too, also')
glossary.ነገረኒ: ነገረ — he told me (3ms perfect, G + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ነገርኩከ: ነገረ — I told you (1cs perfect, G + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.ነገርኩክሙ: ነገረ — I told you (1cs perfect, G + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ንከውን: ኮነ — we shall be (1cp imperf., k-w-n)
glossary.ንጹሐ: ንጹሕ — clean, pure, innocent (adjective; accusative form)
glossary.አሌላ: አሌ — woe to her (interjection አሌ + -ላ 'to her', 3fs)
glossary.አሌሎሙ: አሌ — woe to them (interjection አሌ + -ሎሙ 'to them', 3mp)
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አሐተ: አሐዱ — one (numeral, fem. accusative; አሐተ ብእሲተ 'one woman')
glossary.አሐዝን: ሐዘነ — I grieve (1cs imperfect, G, ḥ-z-n; verb of ሐዘን 'sorrow')
glossary.አሚነ: አሚን — faith, belief (noun, accusative; from አምነ 'believe') (?)
glossary.አርመመት: አርመመ — it grows still, falls silent (3fs perfect, ʾ-r-m-m, a quadriliteral-type verb, not a causative; subject እስትንፋስ) (?)
glossary.አበዊከ: አብ — your fathers (noun, plural አበው + -ka '2ms your')
glossary.አብዝኆ: አብዝኀ — having multiplied, at length (gerund, 3ms, causative of በዝኀ 'be many')
glossary.አኀስር: ኀሰረ — I lose, suffer loss (1cs imperfect, G, ḫ-s-r)
glossary.አነሂ: አነ — I also, I too (1s independent pronoun + enclitic -ሂ 'also')
glossary.አንገሠኒ: አንገሠ — he made me king (3ms perfect, causative of ነገሠ + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.አንጸረ: አንጸረ — he directed, looked toward (3ms perfect, causative of ነጸረ 'look'; አንጸረ ገጾ 'directed his face toward')
glossary.አውሥአ: አውሥአ — he answered (3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
glossary.አውሥኦ: አውሥአ — he answered him (3ms perfect + -ኦ 'him'; the person answered is the object)
glossary.ኢተፈጠርነ: ተፈጥረ — we were not created (ኢ- 'not' + 1cp perfect, passive tä-stem of ፈጠረ)
glossary.ኢየኀድገክሙ: ኀደገ — he will not leave you (ኢ- + 3ms imperfect/subjunctive after ከመ, G, ḫ-d-g, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ኢይበቊዕ: በቊዐ — it is of no use, does not avail (ኢ- negation + 3ms imperfect ይበቊዕ, G)
glossary.ኢገብረ: ገብረ — he did not do (ኢ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ኣነግሦ: አንገሠ — I will make him king (1cs imperfect + -ኦ 'him'; spelled with ኣ-, as elsewhere in this part)
glossary.ኣየድዐከ: አይድዐ — I will make known to you, tell you (1cs imperfect አየድዕ + -ከ '2ms to you'; root y-d-ʿ 'know'; the first-order ኣ- is as printed) (?)
glossary.እምቀዳሚ: ቀዳሚ — from the first, from the beginning (እም- + adj. as noun)
glossary.እምቅድሜየ: ቅድሜ — before me, those who preceded me (እም- + ቅድሜ- + -የ '1cs me')
glossary.እምኵሉ: ኵሉ — out of all, from all (እም- 'from' + ኵሉ)
glossary.እምዘመድከ: ዘመድ — from your kin (እም- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስአለከ: ሰአለ — I ask you (1cs imperfect/subjunctive, G, s-ʾ-l, + -ከ '2ms you'; spelled እስአል- for the usual እሴአል-, cf. ዘእሴአለክሙ)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እበክዮሙ: በከየ — I will weep for them (1cs imperfect/jussive, G, b-k-y, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እግዚእየ: እግዚእ — my lord (noun + -የ '1cs my') · vocative 'my lord' (ብቊዐኒ እግዚእየ) · in apposition, 'David, my lord' (አቡየ ዳዊት እግዚእየ)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ከመዘ: ከመ — like one who (ከመ + ዘ- 'one who', spelled together as ከመዘ)
glossary.ከበርኩ: ከብረ — I have become great, honoured (1cs perfect, G, k-b-r) (?)
glossary.ከዐዉ: ከዐወ — they poured out (3mp perfect, G, k-ʿ-w)
glossary.ክልኤሆን: ክልኤቱ — both of them (feminine; numeral 'two' + -ሆን '3fp', of the hands)
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ወለአበውየ: አብ — and to my fathers (ወ- + ለ- + plural አበው + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ወመንክረ: መንክር — and marvel, wonder (ወ- + noun, accusative)
glossary.ወሙቀተ: ሙቀት — and the warmth of (ወ- + noun 'warmth, heat', construct accusative)
glossary.ወማኅፈርነ: ማኅፈር — and our shame (ወ- + noun 'shame, disgrace' + -ነ '1cp our'; from ኀፈረ 'be ashamed') (?)
glossary.ወሥነ: ሥን — and the beauty of (ወ- + noun 'beauty', construct accusative)
glossary.ወሰፍሐ: ሰፍሐ — and he spread out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, s-f-ḥ)
glossary.ወሶቤሃ: ሶቤሃ — and then, at that time (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወቃለ: ቃል — and the word of (ወ- + noun, construct 'word of')
glossary.ወበሰማያትኒ: ሰማይ — and in the heavens also (ወ- + በ- + plural ሰማያት + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወተመይጠ: ተመይጠ — and he turned (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem of መይጠ)
glossary.ወተጠበብኩ: ተጠበበ — and I was wise, I grew wise (ወ- + 1cs perfect, tä-stem, ṭ-b-b)
glossary.ወትረስ: ወረሰ — and you inherit (ወ- + 2ms subjunctive, G, w-r-s)
glossary.ወኀይለ: ኀይል — and the strength of (ወ- + noun, construct accusative)
glossary.ወንቡር: ንቡር — and standing, abiding (ወ- + adj./participle) · also 'placed, set' (ንቡር ውስቴታ ፲ ቃላት 'ten words are placed within her')
glossary.ወአሐቲ: አሐዱ — and one (ወ- + numeral, fem. አሐቲ)
glossary.ወአንቃዕደወ: አንቃዕደወ — and he looked up, raised his eyes (ወ- + 3ms perfect; stem and root uncertain, not a plain causative) (?)
glossary.ወአንብራ: አንበረ — and place it! (ወ- + 2ms imperative, causative of ነበረ + -ኣ '3fs it')
glossary.ወአንግ: አንገሠ — and make king! (ወ- + the first part, አንግ-, of the 2ms imperative አንግሥ, cut off before its last sign; read with ሦ as ወአንግሦ 'and make him king')
glossary.ወአእምሮ: አእምሮ — and knowledge (ወ- + verbal noun of አእመረ)
glossary.ወአክብሮ: አከበረ — and honour him! (ወ- + 2ms imperative አክብር, causative of ከበረ, + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወአውሥአ: አውሥአ — and he answered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
glossary.ወኢምንትኒ: ኢምንት — and anything at all, nothing (ወ- + noun + enclitic -ኒ; 'not anything' with negative)
glossary.ወኢታምልኮሙ: አምለከ — worship, treat as God (denominal verb from አምላክ; 2ms jussive + -ሙ 'them', 3mp object; ኢ- negative; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወኢትስግድ: ሰገደ — bow down, worship (2ms jussive; ኢ- negative; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወኢትትሀየየኒ: ተሀየየ — and do not turn away from me (ወ- + ኢ- + 2ms jussive, tä-stem + -ኒ 'me'); sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ወኢየሐውሩ: ሖረ — and they do not walk (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp imperfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ወኢየአምኑ: አምነ — and they do not believe (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp imperfect, G, ʾ-m-n)
glossary.ወኢይሰሪ: ሰረየ — and it is not forgiven (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G, s-r-y; 'he does not forgive' is also possible) (?)
glossary.ወኢይትረከብ: ተረክበ — and it is not found (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, passive tä-stem of ረከበ)
glossary.ወኢይደሉ: ደለወ — and it is not fitting, not right (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G, d-l-w; impersonal)
glossary.ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
glossary.ወእምዘርእከ: ዘርእ — and from your seed (ወ- + እም- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወእስራኤልሰ: እስራኤል — and Israel indeed (ወ- + proper name + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወእከውን: ኮነ — and I shall be (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
glossary.ወኵልነ: ኵሉ — and all of us (ወ- + ኵሉ + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወዘርኢኩ: ርእየ — and what I saw (ወ- + ዘ- relative + 1cs perfect, r-ʾ-y)
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወያስቆርሩነ: አስቆረረ — and they grieve us, make us sorrowful (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, causative of ቆረረ + -ነ '1cp us') (?)
glossary.ወያዜክሩ: አዘከረ — and they bring to remembrance, recall (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, causative of ዘከረ; ያዜክሩ the usual imperfect shape, cf. ይዜክር)
glossary.ወያድኅነክሙ: አድኅነ — and he will save you (ወ- + 3ms subjunctive, causative of ድኅነ + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ወይሰቅልዎ: ሰቀለ — and they will crucify him (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, s-q-l, + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወይቀትልዎ: ቀተለ — and they will kill him (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, q-t-l, + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ወይቀንኡ: ቀንአ — and they will be jealous (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, q-n-ʾ)
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይትሀጐሉ: ተሀጕለ — and they perish (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, tä-stem of ሀጕለ 'perish')
glossary.ወይትነሣእ: ተንሥአ — and he rises (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ንሥአ)
glossary.ወይትካፈሉ: ተካፈለ — and they divide among themselves, share out (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, tä-stem of ከፈለ 'divide')
glossary.ወይኩን: ኮነ — and may it be (ወ- 'and' + 3ms jussive, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ወግበራ: ገብረ — and do it! (ወ- + 2ms imperative + -ኣ '3fs it')
glossary.ወጸላእተከ: ጸላኢ — and your foes (ወ- + plural ጸላእት, accusative ጸላእተ, + -ከ '2ms your'; ፀረከ 'your enemy' before it may be collective) (?)
glossary.ወጺአተ: ጽአት — and exit, going out (ወ- + noun, accusative; text unclear with ዕፄ) (?)
glossary.ወጽኑሕ: ጽኑሕ — and firm, heavy, strong (ወ- + adjective)
glossary.ወጽንዐ: ጽንዕ — and might (ወ- + noun, accusative ጽንዐ)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዕፄ: ዕፄ — [ʿəṣe], meaning unclear (?); elsewhere 'emperor', which does not fit here
glossary.ዘለዓለም: ለዓለም — everlasting, eternal (ዘ- 'of' + ለዓለም 'for ever'; ክብረ ዘለዓለም 'glory of eternity')
glossary.ዘመልዕልተ: መልዕልት — which is above (ዘ- relative + መልዕልተ 'above', adverb/preposition, accusative)
glossary.ዘሰማዕኩ: ሰምዐ — what I heard (ዘ- relative + 1cs perfect, s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ዘትቤ: ይቤ — what you said (ዘ- relative + 2ms ትቤ; the prefix forms of defective ይቤ serve as its perfect)
glossary.ዘአልብነ: አልቦ — which we do not have (ዘ- relative + አልብ- + -ነ '1cp we'; the negative existential with suffix)
glossary.ዘይዜክር: ዘከረ — who remembers (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, z-k-r; ይዜክር the usual imperfect shape)
glossary.ዝርዋነ: ዝርው — scattered, dispersed ones (adjective/participle of ዘርወ; plural accusative, predicate)
glossary.ያምዕዑ: አምዐ — they provoke to anger (3mp imperfect, causative IV of ምዕዐ 'be angry', ʾ-m-ʿ; cf. አምዕዕዎ)
glossary.ይመጽእ: መጽአ — he comes (3ms subjunctive, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ይምሐሩነ: ምሕረ — they have mercy on us, show us mercy (3mp subjunctive, G, m-ḥ-r, written with ሐ, + -ነ '1cp us'; the subject is unclear) (?)
glossary.ይሰቅልዎ: ሰቀለ — they will crucify him (3mp imperfect, G, s-q-l, + -ኦ '3ms him')
glossary.ይቤሎ: ብህለ — he said to him (3ms perfect ይቤ of the defective verb b-h-l, + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ይትሀጐል: ተሀጕለ — he/it perishes (3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ሀጕለ)
glossary.ይትረሳዕ: ተረስዐ — it is forgotten (3ms imperfect, passive tä-stem of ረስዐ 'forget')
glossary.ይከውኑ: ኮነ — they will be (3mp imperfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ይክዕዉ: ከዐወ — they pour out, shed (3mp imperfect, G, k-ʿ-w; cf. ከዐዉ)
glossary.ይጠቅሉ: ጠቀለ — they seize, lay hold of (3mp imperfect, G, ṭ-q-l; 'wrap, gather') (?)
glossary.ይጠፍኡ: ጠፍአ — they will perish (3mp imperfect, G, ṭ-f-ʾ)
glossary.ይጠፍእ: ጠፍአ — he/it vanishes, perishes (3ms imperfect, G, ṭ-f-ʾ)
glossary.ይጸልኡ: ጸለአ — they hate (3mp imperfect, G, ṣ-l-ʾ)
glossary.ዮርብዓም: ኢዮርብዓም — Jeroboam (proper name; spelled without the initial ኢ)
glossary.ደሞ: ደም — his blood (noun + -ኦ '3ms his', written ደሞ; as ገጾ)
glossary.ደቂቅነ: ደቂቅ — our sons (plural noun + -ነ '1cp our') · 'our children' (ደቂቅ plural 'children' + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ድቀቶሙ: ድቀት — their fall (noun, fem., from ወድቀ 'fall' + -ሙ '3mp their' with the linking vowel -o-, as ኀጢአቶሙ; -ሆሙ is the form after a final vowel)
glossary.ጡማር: ጦማር — scroll, book (noun; spelled ጡማር here) (?)
glossary.ጥዩቀ: ጥዩቅ — certain, exact; 'certainly' (adjective, accusative/adverbial form in -a)
glossary.ፍቁራኒነ: ፍቁር — our loved ones (noun, plural ፍቁራን + -ነ '1cp our')
glossary.ፍኖቶሙ: ፍኖት — their road (noun + -ሆሙ '3mp their', written -ቶሙ) · or, as in ድቀቶሙ and ኀጢአቶሙ, ፍኖት + -ሙ with the linking vowel -o-; -ሆሙ is the form after a final vowel (?)
glossary.፫: ፫ — 3, spoken ሠለስቱ (śälästu) 'three'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'three' (መጠነ ፫ እመት 'to the measure of three cubits'; ፫ ልብስ 'three garments'); spoken ሠለስ (śäläs) (?) before a feminine noun such as እመት, ሠለስቱ with a masculine · after a noun, 'third' (ወልድከ ፫ 'your third son'), the spoken ordinal ሣልስ (śalləs) (?)
glossary.፷፱: ፷፱ — 69, spoken ስሳ ወተስዐቱ (səssa wä-täsʿatu) 'sixty-nine' (numeral; chapter number)
